p='parsing/html/reader_test.go'
s=open(p).read()

s=s.replace('"-href": "?a=1&b=2"', '"-href": "?a=1\\u0026b=2"')
s=s.replace('"script": "if (a < b && c > d) { x = \\"&\\"; }"', '"script": "if (a \\u003c b \\u0026\\u0026 c \\u003e d) { x = \\"\\u0026amp;\\"; }"')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
go test ./parsing/html/ -run TestHtmlReader -v 2>&1 | tail -30
